applicableAreas: Consolidated Site Plan Application, Section 8 (Site Area Information)
findings.comment: Limits of Construction field in Section 8 (Site Area Information) is left blank with no value entered. This field is required to be completed as part of the net site area, limits of construction, proposed use, existing use, and existing zoning table on page 5.
Limits of Construction field is left blank rather than completed with a value or explicitly marked 'N/A'. All required fields must be either completed or clearly marked N/A.

Engineer's certification seal on cover sheet is dated 2/27/26 (February 27, 2026), which is approximately 10 months after the application submittal date of April 8, 2025. All documents must reflect dates consistent with the current application date or earlier. Future-dated seals are not acceptable.

Application is executed by a legal entity (WM 41 Austin RE, LLC) through Richard D. Agnew, Authorized Signer, but no corporate resolution, operating agreement extract, or other instrument demonstrating the signatory's authority to bind the entity is provided in the submittal package.

Applicant (Jason Rodgers, P.E., Bleyl Engineering) is not the property owner (WM 41 Austin RE, LLC). No written authorization letter from the record owner authorizing the third-party applicant to submit the application on its behalf is provided.

Owner is a legal entity (WM 41 Austin RE, LLC). The signatory (Richard D. Agnew) is identified only as 'Authorized Signer' without a specific corporate title (Manager, Member, CEO, etc.). No documentation of legal authority to bind the entity is provided, such as a corporate resolution, operating agreement extract, or similar instrument.

Warranty deed is not provided to establish current ownership of the subject property. Application references Document Number 2019197883, but the actual deed document is not included in the submittal package.

Affidavit of No Liens is not provided in the application submittal. A formally notarized Affidavit signed by the record owner or authorized agent with notary signature, official seal, and acknowledgment date is required.
Ownership and Lien Search Certificate from a third-party title company is not provided. This document must be current within 30 days of the application submittal date.

ESCP (Erosion and Sedimentation Control Plan) County field on Sheet 5 was not examined in detail. Verification that the TRAVIS county field is completed in the Site Information table is not verifiable from the available visual analysis.
